moments.text: Infrared view over a low coastal site: buildings, tall masts and a jetty, with water along the bottom. Crosshair at centre; redaction boxes at the edges.
A very faint pale dash emerges by the lower right redaction box, streaks left and down over the water, and leaves the bottom edge near centre.

notes: Object is very faint; only clearly visible with frame differencing or close viewing.
